# markov

## Introduction

The `markov` R package provides tools for statistical inference on
finite, discrete-time Markov chains and the analysis of system
reliability.

### Key Features

- Simulation and estimation of Markov chains.
- Transition probabilities and stationary distributions.
- Reliability, availability, and maintainability measures.
- Hypothesis testing and uncertainty estimation.

## Installation

You can install the release version of `markov` from CRAN by running the
following line of code:

``` r

 install.packages("markov")
```

You can install the development version of `markov` from github by
running the following line of code:

``` r

 devtools::install_github("thechibo/markov")
```

More details can be found in the [markov Github
repository](https://github.com/thechibo/markov "markov Github repository").

## Documentation

Detailed documentation, along with reproducible examples, can be found
in the package vignette
[`vignette(topic = "markov", package = "markov")`](articles/markov.md).

# Package index

## All functions

- [`Pdecomp()`](Pdecomp.md) : Eigendecomposition of a Transition Matrix
- [`Ppower()`](Ppower.md) : Power of a Transition Matrix
- [`Ppowers()`](Ppowers.md) : Successive Powers of a Transition Matrix
- [`avail()`](avail.md) : Availability of a Markov Chain
- [`bmpf()`](bmpf.md) : BMP Failure Rate of a Markov Chain
- [`cp()`](cp.md) : Matrix Transformed Cross-Product
- [`cron()`](cron.md) : Kronecker Delta Vector
- [`dssc()`](dssc.md) : Down-State Survival Curve of a Markov Chain
- [`dti()`](dti.md) : Discrete-Time Intensity of Hitting Down
- [`estim_parallel()`](estim_parallel.md) : Simulate and Estimate Markov
  Chain Functionals
- [`fit()`](fit.md) : Estimate a Markov Chain from One or More
  Trajectories
- [`ftp()`](ftp.md) : Failure-Time Probability of a Markov Chain
- [`is_com_class()`](is_com_class.md) : Validate a Communicating Class
- [`is_irreducible()`](is_irreducible.md) : Test Whether a Markov Chain
  is Irreducible
- [`is_rec_class()`](is_rec_class.md) : Identify a Recurrent Class
- [`kp()`](kp.md) : Matrix Kronecker Product
- [`main()`](main.md) : Maintainability of a Markov Chain
- [`mc_classes()`](mc_classes.md) : Communicating Classes
- [`mttf()`](mttf.md) : Mean Time to Failure
- [`mttr()`](mttr.md) : Mean Time to Recovery
- [`nstates()`](nstates.md) : Number of States
- [`opaque2`](opaque2.md) : Maize Opaque-2 Genomic DNA Sequence
- [`is_positive_integer()`](positive_integer.md)
  [`as_positive_integer()`](positive_integer.md) : Validate or Coerce
  Positive Integer Values
- [`rel()`](rel.md) : Reliability of a Markov Chain
- [`rgf()`](rgf.md) : RG Failure Rate of a Markov Chain
- [`savail()`](savail.md) : Stationary Availability of a Markov Chain
- [`sim()`](sim.md) : Simulate Markov Chain Trajectories
- [`stat()`](stat.md) : Stationary Distribution of a Markov Chain
- [`stat_on_class()`](stat_on_class.md) : Stationary Distribution on a
  Recurrent Class
- [`set_state_names()`](state_names.md)
  [`get_state_names()`](state_names.md) : Get or Set State Names
- [`test_const()`](test_const.md) : Test Constancy of Markov Transition
  Probabilities across Time
- [`test_prob()`](test_prob.md) : Test a Specified Markov Transition
  Probability
- [`var_mttf()`](var_mttf.md) : Asymptotic Variance of the

- [`var_mttr()`](var_mttr.md) : Asymptotic Variance of the

- [`vcov_avail()`](vcov_avail.md) : Variance of availability
- [`vcov_bmp()`](vcov_bmp.md) : Asymptotic Variance of the BMP Failure

- [`vcov_dssc()`](vcov_dssc.md) : Asymptotic Variance of Down-State

- [`vcov_dssc_sl()`](vcov_dssc_sl.md) : Component-wise Reference for

- [`vcov_dti()`](vcov_dti.md) : Asymptotic Variance of the Discrete-Time
  Intensity
- [`vcov_ftp()`](vcov_ftp.md) : Asymptotic Variance of the Failure-Time

- [`vcov_main()`](vcov_main.md) : Asymptotic Variance of Maintainability
- [`vcov_main_sl()`](vcov_main_sl.md) : Component-wise Reference for

- [`vcov_p()`](vcov_p.md) : Asymptotic Variance–Covariance of the

- [`vcov_stat()`](vcov_stat.md) : Asymptotic Variance–Covariance Matrix
